title: The Jar Full of Fireflies
summary: When the fireflies get lost in the fog, little Lumie shines a golden path to bring them home.
tagged: [happy][gesture:wave] Hello, little friend, I am Lumie, and I live in a cosy glass jar on a wooden shelf. [neutral] Every night the fireflies come to visit me, and together we light up the whole garden. [curious] But one night the fireflies did not come, and the garden stayed very dark. [sad] I waited and waited, and my little flame grew small and quiet. [thinking][gesture:think] Where could a whole family of fireflies have gone? [listening] Then I heard a tiny tapping on the glass. [surprised][gesture:surprisePop] It was the youngest firefly, so small that its light was no bigger than a grain of sand! [scared] The others were caught in the fog by the pond and could not see the way back. [excited][gesture:bounce] So I took a deep breath and shone as brightly as I could! [happy] My warm light slipped through the fog like a soft golden path. [love][gesture:celebrate] One by one, the fireflies followed it home, and the garden twinkled again. [laughing][gesture:giggle] The littlest firefly did a happy loop around my jar and tickled my nose. [pause:0.8][sleepy][gesture:yawn] Now the fireflies are blinking slower and slower, and so am I. [sleepy][gesture:sleep] Good night, little friend, I will keep a tiny light on just for you.
